title: Operator Inequalities and Several Characterizations of the $λ$-Mean Transform
summary: We broaden Buzano-type inequalities to provide novel numerical radius bounds for operators of the type $AXB$, thereby generalizing the results obtained by Sababheh et al. For the $λ$-mean transform $M_λ(T)$, we provide a counterexample demonstrating that $r_σ(M_λ(T)) \le r_σ(T)$ fails to hold in general for $λ\in (0, 1)$, establish that $(r_ω(M_λ(T)))^n$ and $r_ω(T^n)$ are typically incomparable for $n \ge 2$, and confirm that $M_λ(T^*) = (M_λ(T))^*$ is valid for $λ\in [0, 1)$ if and only if $T$ is a member of a newly established $σ$-class.
